title: 修改预约时间和人数
Change booking time and guests
customer_help: 提交后会通知店主，预约将变为待确认，请等待店主重新确认。
The host will be notified. Your booking will be pending until the host confirms it again.
completed_help: 原到店记录、结算和已获积分会保留，新安排需重新确认。
Your previous visit, settlement and points will be kept. The new schedule needs confirmation.
admin_help: 更改时间和人数会保留当前状态；如需更改状态，请在下方选择。
Changing the schedule keeps its status. To change the status, choose it below.
saved: 修改已提交，等待店主确认。
Changes submitted. Waiting for the host to confirm.
invalid: 请选择有效的日期、时间和人数。
Choose a valid date, time and number of guests.
version_conflict: 预约已被更新，请重新读取后核对，再提交修改。
This booking has changed. Reload and review it before submitting.
reservation_edit_request_changed: 重试内容已改变，请重新核对预约后提交。
The retry content changed. Review the booking and submit again.
reservation_edit_plan_locked: 本次只可修改日期、时间和人数，体验类型保持不变。
You can change the date, time and guests. The experience stays the same.
